name: Forbes & Company Limited
about: Forbes & Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development activities in India and internationally. It operates through Coding and Industrial Automation and Real Estate segments. The Coding and Industrial Automation segment manufactures and trades in conventional and automation marking system and industrial automation business. The Real Estate segment rents, invests, and develops real estate projects and properties. The company was founded in 1767 and is based in Mumbai, India. Forbes & Company Limited is a subsidiary of Shapoorji Pallonji and Company Private Limited.
